deities: Durga Mata (idol in the mandir, per Moga district site)
Balaji (weekly Sunday-morning pooja, per Moga district site)

history.summary: Shree Geeta Bhawan Mandir is described by the Moga district administration as the famous Hindu temple in Moga, situated in Vedant Nagar on the south corner of the city. The district site records a daily aarti at 11 AM and 7 PM, with weekly poojas for Balaji on Sunday mornings and for Durga Maa on Tuesday evenings. No published source gives its founding date or builder (verify). Note: the Google-hosted image used has no source page, so its identity as this mandir is probable but not fully verified.

name: Geeta Bhawan
town_description: Moga is a city and district headquarters in Punjab, on the Ferozepur-Ludhiana corridor about 30 km east of Ferozepur. It is a regional trading and agricultural centre in the Malwa belt.

travel.airport: Mohali (~159 km) and Chandigarh (~169 km), per the Moga district site.
travel.railway: Moga railway station (Northern Railway); connected to Ferozepur, Ludhiana, Chandigarh, Ambala, and Delhi.
travel.road: In Vedant Nagar, south of Moga city, about 3 km from the bus stand (per the Moga district site).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March (general Punjab climate guidance - verify).
visitor_information.opening_hours: 06:00-19:00 daily, till 20:00 on Tuesday and Sunday (per Justdial - verify); aarti daily at 11 AM and 7 PM (per Moga district site).
